categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Purchase order item is resolved via a 3-way match where the goods receipt is recorded before the invoice receipt, advancing value-matching control integrity and working-capital efficiency while incurring matching overhead, judged against Indicator 17.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 5, supported by frequent process variants like V0001 and V0002 where goods receipt precedes invoice creation/receipt.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Purchase order item is resolved via a 3-way match where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt, helping control integrity and timely clearance, judged against Indicator 18.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 6, evidenced by variants such as V0007 where invoice receipt occurs prior to goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Purchase order item is resolved via a 2-way match where no goods receipt is required, minimizing procurement overhead and evaluated against Indicator 19.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id 7 as part of the OR-decomposition for item resolution regimes.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
